description: This file contains the implementation of the TextFrameRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering text frames in a PDF document, including formatting and drawing content with specific orientations.

classes.name: TextFrameRenderer
classes.description: A class that handles rendering of text frames within the MigraDoc rendering engine, leveraging PdfSharp for drawing operations and managing transformation states.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the text frame for rendering, creating a FormattedTextFrame object and applying the formatting to it.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the text frame, including filling, content, and line rendering.

methods.name: RenderContent
methods.description: Handles rendering the formatted text content, applying transformations for orientation.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Applies translation and rotation transforms based on the text orientation of the text frame.

methods.name: ResetTransform
methods.description: Restores the graphics state after transformations to ensure proper subsequent rendering.
